description:
In this video I'm sharing a live coaching segment from my in-person workshop where I'm coaching @AnthonyVizzari to improve his public speaking skills
PREORDER MY NEW BOOK: https://vinhgiang.com/before-we-forget-how-to-connect..

FREE  Training ➡ https://free.vinhgiang.com/avsw-frameworks

Anthony's an exceptional communicator but what I find inspiring about him is that being great didn't stop him from joining my class to continue learning, identify his blindspots and fix them.

Thanks Anthony for allowing me to share this masterclass - you're a legend 🔥

Make sure to check out his socials and follow his content! 
YT: https://www.youtube.com/@UCpw20FOo6Q169lT4KDZjIGA 
IG: https://www.instagram.com/anthonyvizzari

TIMESTAMPS:
0:00 - Intro
0:36 - Anthony's story
2:38 - What he did great
3:06 - What he can improve (blindspots)

If you found this video helpful and want to see more of my live communication coaching on stage, comment LIVE COACHING so my team and I can get a sense check!

FREE  Training ➡ https://free.vinhgiang.com/avsw-frameworks

=== About Vinh Giang ===
Vinh Giang is an internationally acclaimed keynote speaker, communication skills expert, and magician. He blends his unique talents to captivate audiences and deliver powerful lessons on the art of influence, persuasion, and effective communication. His mission is to empower individuals and leaders to communicate with clarity, confidence, and impact, enabling them to unlock new levels of success in both their personal and professional lives.
